entries.en: The history book describes the effect of the trade embargo.
entries.zh: 这本历史书描述了贸易禁运的影响。

entries.meaningZh: 愤世嫉俗的；怀疑动机的
entries.en: His cynical comments made every kind gesture sound suspicious.
entries.zh: 他愤世嫉俗的评论让每个善意举动都显得可疑。

entries.en: Rain glistened on the roof's dark slate tiles.
entries.zh: 雨水在屋顶的深色板岩瓦上闪亮。

entries.en: Without my glasses, the distant houses were a blur.
entries.zh: 没戴眼镜，远处的房屋在我眼里一片模糊。

entries.en: Nobody could foresee how popular the little café would become.
entries.zh: 没有人能预料这家小咖啡馆后来会多么受欢迎。

entries.en: The shed holds bags of fertilizer and spare flowerpots.
entries.zh: 棚屋里存放着一袋袋肥料和备用花盆。

entries.en: At her insistence, we checked the map one more time.
entries.zh: 在她的坚持下，我们又看了一遍地图。

entries.en: His workbench stayed tidy even during the busiest week.
entries.zh: 即使在最忙的一周，他的工作台也保持整洁。

entries.en: Our celebration was premature because another round remained.
entries.zh: 我们庆祝得太早了，因为比赛还剩一轮。

entries.en: Her memoir describes the hardship of growing up during wartime.
entries.zh: 她的回忆录描述了战时成长的艰难。

entries.en: The label would not adhere to the damp jar.
entries.zh: 标签粘不住那个潮湿的罐子。

entries.en: The shepherd led the flock towards the hillside shelter.
entries.zh: 牧羊人领着羊群走向山坡上的棚屋。

entries.en: We manoeuvred the sofa through the narrow doorway.
entries.zh: 我们小心调整方向，把沙发搬过了狭窄的门口。

entries.meaningZh: 无望的；没有成功可能的
entries.en: Finding one small earring in that field seemed hopeless.
entries.zh: 想在那片田野里找到一只小耳环，似乎毫无希望。

entries.en: An aeroplane passed overhead, leaving a white trail.
entries.zh: 一架飞机从头顶飞过，留下一道白色尾迹。

entries.en: The builders stacked bags of cement beside the wall.
entries.zh: 建筑工人把一袋袋水泥堆在墙边。

entries.en: The hostel has a communal kitchen on the ground floor.
entries.zh: 旅舍一楼有一个共用厨房。

entries.en: Our club secretary will preside over tonight's meeting.
entries.zh: 俱乐部秘书将主持今晚的会议。

entries.en: A petty argument about chairs delayed the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 一场关于椅子的琐碎争吵耽误了排练。

entries.en: The dark clouds warned us that rain was imminent.
entries.zh: 乌云提醒我们，雨马上就要来了。

entries.en: We underestimated how long it would take to paint the fence.
entries.zh: 我们低估了给篱笆刷漆所需的时间。

entries.en: I was sceptical of his claim to remember every guest's name.
entries.zh: 他说自己记得每位客人的名字，我对此表示怀疑。

entries.en: We chose robust chairs for the busy community hall.
entries.zh: 我们为使用频繁的社区大厅挑了结实的椅子。

entries.en: She prepared a lovely meal without any fuss.
entries.zh: 她从容地准备了一顿美餐。

entries.en: A bright scarf can be a useful winter accessory.
entries.zh: 一条亮色围巾可以成为实用的冬季配饰。

entries.en: The fallen apple was already rotten on one side.
entries.zh: 掉落的苹果有一面已经腐烂了。

entries.en: Pink blossom covered the branches above the garden bench.
entries.zh: 花园长椅上方的树枝开满了粉红色的花。

entries.en: The ambiguous ending left us arguing about the hero's fate.
entries.zh: 含糊的结尾让我们争论起主人公的命运。

entries.en: The story's villain imprisons the prince in a tower.
entries.zh: 故事中的反派把王子囚禁在一座塔里。

entries.en: Her family waited near the finish of the marathon.
entries.zh: 她的家人在马拉松终点附近等候。
